name: Masquerader Caines

intro.text: Masquerade dancers at Christmas and St Patrick's: ribbons, mirrors, a very tall hat. I'm a Mocko Jumbie in my spare time.

win: Fair play. The ribbons are yours.
after: A Mocko Jumbie is a stilt-walker, meant to look down on evil spirits. Also on people. It's very hard to be modest at three metres.
